description: Staging cost budget (AUT-112, owner decision O16), planned by infra/terraform/envs/staging-core. Changed only through a reviewed pull request. The alert recipient is NOT stored here: it is the BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL secret of the staging-plan environment, because the repository is public and GitHub prints plain variables in job logs. The plan refuses to run while monthly_limit_usd is null (undecided).
name: veda-staging-monthly-cost
decision: O16, 2026-10-05: forecast alerts at 80% and 100% of the monthly limit, by email to the owner's address. The monthly limit is undecided.
